subject: Computação
description_pt: Descrever com precisão a solução de um problema, construindo o programa que implementa a solução descrita. Construir e analisar soluções computacionais de problemas de diferentes áreas do conhecimento, de forma individual ou colaborativa, selecionando as estruturas de dados adequadas (registros, matrizes, listas e grafos), aperfeiçoando e articulando saberes escolares.

components.description_pt: Descrever a solução de um problema em linguagem precisa e inequívoca antes de codificar
components.description_en: Describe a problem's solution in precise, unambiguous language before coding
components.cc_component_description: Communicate a design solution in written or oral form with sufficient detail for others to evaluate or replicate it

components.description_pt: Construir um programa que implemente uma solução algorítmica previamente descrita
components.description_en: Construct a program that implements a previously described algorithmic solution
components.cc_component_description: Construct or implement a designed solution that demonstrably meets specified criteria and constraints

components.description_pt: Selecionar estruturas de dados apropriadas (registros, arrays, listas ou grafos) para um problema
components.description_en: Select appropriate data structures (records, arrays, lists, or graphs) for a given problem
components.cc_component_description: Select an appropriate organizational format (table, chart, graph) for a given data set

components.description_pt: Analisar uma solução computacional para avaliar sua correção e eficiência
components.description_en: Analyze a computational solution to evaluate its correctness and efficiency
components.cc_component_description: Interpret algorithmic representations to evaluate the validity of a proposed solution

components.description_pt: Refinar uma solução computacional conectando-a a conhecimentos de outras áreas
components.description_en: Refine a computational solution by connecting it to knowledge from other subject areas
components.cc_component_description: Apply scientific concepts to generate or refine a solution to an engineering design problem

cc_matches.description: Communicate information or design ideas and/or solutions with others in oral and/or written forms using models, drawings, writing, or numbers that provide detail about scientific ideas, practices, and/or design ideas.
Apply scientific ideas to solve design problems.
Undertake a design project, engaging in the design cycle, to construct and/or implement a solution that meets specific design criteria and constraints.
Organize simple data sets to reveal patterns that suggest relationships.
Use mathematical, computational, and/or algorithmic representations of phenomena or design solutions to describe and/or support claims and/or explanations.
